words: The Lark Base board with four columns: New, On Going Engagement, Follow Up, Successful. You move a player by dragging the card.
Filled automatically each time you drag a card. Never edit it directly.
The only official source for Telegram KPI. If a figure looks wrong, tell the ATL; never recalculate by hand.
Refreshed daily so new players enter the workflow and player levels stay current.
HIGH: at least 10 meaningful replies. MEDIUM: about 3 to 5. LOW: one reply, an emoji, or nothing. [CONFIRM] Which level for exactly 2 replies, and for 6 to 9?
Set automatically from days since last deposit: Level 0 (1 day), 1 (2 to 3 days), 2 (4 to 7 days), 3 (8 days and above). Harder levels weigh more in the score.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Is the tracker up to date?
items: Every player you contacted is out of New
Each card sits in the column that matches where the player really is
The PIC on each card is right
tour.done: Your engagement and follow-ups will count correctly.
tour.notYet: Fix it now: a contacted player left in New is not recorded, and a wrong PIC credits someone else.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: The card's journey
items: New
RTN Leaders add target churn players to the Player List. Cards start here.
On Going Engagement
Drag here when you start contact.
Follow Up
Drag here when the player needs more nurturing.
Successful
Drag here when the player is reactivated and deposits.
Record quality
Mark the engagement quality: HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Delete a player or record. Use an archival status; deleting loses the history.
Edit the Score Table directly. Only drag cards.
Recalculate the KPI by hand. The Report Table is the only official source.
Leave a contacted player in New.

tour.label: Reactivation
tour.title: When does it count as reactivated?
items: Official count
Uses month-end P&L only.
Real time
Not available. A successful chat can happen before the official Reactivated flag appears.
Final word
The Report Table.

tour.label: Wrong figure
tour.title: A KPI figure looks wrong
tour.q: Does a number in the Report Table look wrong to you?
tour.yes: Escalate it to the ATL. Do not recalculate it yourself or edit any table.
tour.no: Keep working the board. Drag cards as players move.

pool.q: You just sent your first message to a player in New. What do you do on the board?
o: Drag the card to On Going Engagement
pool.why: Drag New to On Going Engagement when you start contact. A contacted player left in New is not recorded.

pool.q: A player on the board is no longer relevant. What do you do?
pool.why: Never delete records; use an archival status. Deleting loses the history (critical mistake).

pool.q: Your Follow Up count looks too low. Can you fix it in the Score Table?
o: No; only drag cards, and escalate odd figures to the ATL
pool.why: No direct edits to the Score Table. The Report Table is the official source; escalate anomalies to the ATL.

pool.q: When do you drag a card to Successful?
o: When the player is reactivated and deposits

pool.q: A chat had 12 meaningful replies. Which engagement quality?
pool.why: HIGH is at least 10 meaningful replies.

pool.q: The player answered with one thumbs-up emoji. Which quality?
pool.why: LOW: one reply, an emoji, or nothing.

pool.q: A player you chatted with deposited today. Why might the Report Table not show them as reactivated yet?
o: Official reactivation uses month-end P&L only
pool.why: Real-time reactivation is not available. Official counts use month-end P&L.

pool.q: A card shows the wrong PIC. Why does it matter?
o: The score is credited to the wrong person
pool.why: A wrong PIC credits the score to the wrong person (high severity).
